conf.description: Tanium discover, syslog-kv: KVP-extract the flat key=value line into tanium_fields, map asset columns to host.*, tag event.dataset.

conf.comment: Tanium discover / syslog-kv: Connect emits one line of key=value pairs per asset. serde-KVP into tanium_fields, map HostName/IpAddress/MacAddress/Managed/Ports (the columns named in the format's enable text) to host.hostname/host.ip/host.mac and custom booleans/array, set _time from UpdatedAt (named only in recommendation prose) with a fallback, tag event.dataset. Per-run dedupe on row id + UpdatedAt is recommended but NOT implemented: no confidently-attested 'row id' column name exists in this work order, and guessing one risks a silently-wrong distinct group. Direct route, no guard hop.

functions.description: Message body: a Cribl Syslog Source leaves the full line, header included, in _raw and the body in message; anything else carries the body in _raw.
extract the tab/space-delimited key=value attributes into a nested tanium_fields object
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
